affinity.notes: Mineralized segments, crystalline growth, broken-ground wake, and dust change material, silhouette, and environment beyond hue.

anatomy.notes: The primary body is continuous, compressed against the ground, and ends in a complete visible tail.

archetype.notes: Eruptive ground wake and floor disruption communicate ground-eruption-disruptor duty.

counterplay.notes: The declared soft rear segments are covered in the same hard rocky armor as the forward body, leaving no readable vulnerable rear after surfacing.

finish.notes: Canvas is fully rendered with coherent detail and no text, UI, watermark, or blank region.

framing.notes: Two tall curling foreground ridges resemble additional segmented worms and compromise the exactly-one-subject silhouette and clear body continuity.

identity.notes: Continuous limbless segmented worm identity, circular mouth, and tapered rear remain recognizable.

tier.notes: Presentation remains bridge-only and makes no canonical family or T1-T5 tier claim.
